content: watchdog ships a built-in EventDebouncer (watchdog.utils.event_debouncer, documented in official examples): debounce_interval + events_callback receives coalesced event list after directory goes quiet; timer resets on each new event; flushes accrued events on stop. Editors emit created+multiple modified per logical save, so debouncing before reindex is mandatory; mtime+size settle-check (amd/gaia pattern) avoids reading half-written files.
